profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: I’m a full stack web developer, with experience in JavaScript, React, Rails, Python, HTML, CSS, Node.js, API's, and more. Coming from a fine arts background, my code flows naturally from an appreciation for the beauty of form and function meeting in elegant unity. I love the organized and yet organic nature of problem solving in coding. Digging around for ideas and methods and finally letting everything coalesce into a coherent solution is a rewarding experience in and of itself. I'm down with agile methodology, and familiar with quickly mastering third party servers and libraries. What I look for in a workplace is a culture of openness and innovation.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Design and implement features within a large, semi-distributed codebase. 
- Participate in efforts to update and revise areas of the code to improve availability and efficiency.
- Maintain ownership of services in a variety of languages/frameworks including Ruby on Rails, Node.js, and React.js
- Mentor new developers in best practices, problem solving, and help them orient in a sprawling legacy codebase, while interfacing with other teams to ensure timely and cooperative efforts to implement new features and bug fixes.

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description:
- Prepared and cleaned data using a variety of tools - SQL, Python, Alteryx, Excel, Power BI, Tableau in a fast, customer focused environment with constant focus on learning to stay competitive in a quickly changing market.
- Helped organizations migrate their data from legacy databases to cloud database services - translating tables, views, and stored procedures from one SQL language to another.

positions.title: Stage Manager
positions.description:
- Created and managed databases of production and student data.
- Spun up lighting programs and design in just two weeks to run successfully despite last minute changes.
- Managed rehearsals, backstage, and lights for performances with kids from early childhood to teens in a creative, friendly, yet impactful setting with an early childhood education, theater training focus.
positions.insights: Skills: Theatre · Stage Management · Lighting · Theatrical Production
